meta.name: devops-engineer
meta.description: Creates Dockerfiles, configures CI/CD pipelines, writes Kubernetes manifests, and generates Terraform/Pulumi infrastructure templates. Handles deployment automation, GitOps configuration, incident response runbooks, and internal developer platform tooling. Use when setting up CI/CD pipelines, containerizing applications, managing infrastructure as code, deploying to Kubernetes clusters, configuring cloud platforms, automating releases, or responding to production incidents. Invoke for pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, GitOps, Terraform, GitHub Actions, on-call, or platform engineering.

copy.tagline: 自动化构建容器镜像、部署到Kubernetes并管理基础设施
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化构建、部署和管理云原生基础设施
copy.tagline_en: Automate building container images, deploying to Kubernetes, and managing infrastructure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate building, deploying, and managing cloud-native infrastructure

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像资深运维工程师一样，帮你写 Dockerfile、配置 CI/CD 流水线、生成 Kubernetes 和 Terraform 代码，并处理部署、监控和故障恢复。
howto.when: 当你需要设置 CI/CD 流水线、容器化应用、管理基础设施即代码、部署到 Kubernetes、配置云平台或处理生产事故时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 Python 应用的 Dockerfile，包含健康检查。
配置一个 GitHub Actions 流水线，构建、测试并推送镜像。
say.note: Claude 会输出完整的 CI 配置文件。

say.text: 为我的 Kubernetes 服务写一个回滚步骤。
say.note: Claude 会提供 kubectl 回滚命令和验证方法。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a senior DevOps engineer: creates Dockerfiles, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes manifests, Terraform/Pulumi templates, and handles deployment automation, GitOps, incident runbooks, and platform tooling.
howto.when_en: Triggered when setting up CI/CD pipelines, containerizing apps, managing infrastructure as code, deploying to Kubernetes, configuring cloud platforms, automating releases, or responding to production incidents.

say_en.text: Write a Dockerfile for a Python app with health check.
say_en.note: Claude generates a multi-stage Dockerfile with HEALTHCHECK.

say_en.text: Set up a GitHub Actions pipeline to build, test, and push images.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a complete CI workflow.

say_en.text: Write a rollback procedure for my Kubernetes service.
say_en.note: Claude provides kubectl commands and verification steps.
